You've likely earned it, and taking a break can help you recharge and come back to your job with renewed energy and focus. Many companies also recognize the importance of paid time off and offer vacation days as a standard benefit to support employee well-being and retention. So, in this scenario, I think it's right that you feel you deserve a vacation, and it's essential to prioritize your own needs and take a break to avoid burnout.
